item.title: A broad measure of American incomes reached a record high last year as upper-income households fared well and women’s pay gained ground compared with men

item.title: Canada Wholesale Sales Rose in July
item.content:encoded: Wholesale sales rose 0.3% from the month before to a seasonally adjusted 93.09 billion Canadian dollars, the equivalent of US$66.96 billion, Statistics Canada said.

item.title: New York Manufacturing Activity Decelerated in September
item.content:encoded: The Federal Reserve Bank of New York said its statewide manufacturing index of business conditions came in at 7.6, pulling back from a four-year high of 20.6 in August.

item.title: U.S. 10-Year Yield Cools After Topping 5%, German Bund Yield Hits 15-Year High
